summary.text: James Buchanan represents District 74 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Buchanan was first elected in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Buchanan is a real estate broker who lives in Sarasota; Buchanan was born in Michigan and moved to Florida in 1992.
Buchanan holds a bachelor's degree in finance from Florida State University and an MBA from the University of South Florida.
